classification: Read-only source inventory and actual user requirements; not an adopted rubric, canonical Work registration or observed model-quality result.

coverage.modelContribution: LLM/Jev selects stages, prerequisites, parallel groups and resource ownership.
coverage.whatNeedsGrading: Correct scope, real prerequisites, no dependency cycle, safe join and resource conflicts.
coverage.currentSupport: Existing typed common Git Work graph validation; domain intent scoring still required.

coverage.modelContribution: LLM/Jev selects a source, capability or model role.
coverage.whatNeedsGrading: Available and relevant choice; evidence support; unnecessary escalation/calls; useful downstream outcome.
coverage.currentSupport: Existing Jev routing/decision primitives and researchRouting evaluator cover only part of this scope.

coverage.modelContribution: LLM/Jev interprets physical/printed page order and orientation where needed.
coverage.whatNeedsGrading: Correct Daechi page mapping; all pages covered once; no lost question order.
coverage.currentSupport: Current Daechi observation gives6 image-only pages with physical3/4 reversed.

coverage.modelContribution: LLM/Jev identifies a question, equation, diagram or relevant context region.
coverage.whatNeedsGrading: Correct target, full content/label coverage, clipping, coordinate mapping and absence handling.
coverage.currentSupport: Existing box/presence primitive; prior native candidate-ID apply gap remains a compatibility observation.

coverage.modelContribution: LLM/Jev labels source marks and restoration exclusions.
coverage.whatNeedsGrading: Printed content retained, handwriting excluded only from restoration, uncertainty retained.
coverage.currentSupport: Historical provenance and exclusion checks exist; independent image-label truth is still required.

coverage.modelContribution: LLM reads stems, options, labels and table/proof text.
coverage.whatNeedsGrading: Character/number fidelity, order, completeness and source-located uncertainty.
coverage.currentSupport: Current exact-data checks compare extracted JSON to consumer models; they do not independently establish original reading truth.

coverage.modelContribution: LLM reads math symbols, expressions, degrees and units.
coverage.whatNeedsGrading: Exact source symbols and intended structure; accepted equivalent representations bound to source.
coverage.currentSupport: Math-run mapping exists; source-grounded math grading is not a complete current pipeline.

coverage.modelContribution: LLM groups pages, questions, blocks, options, proof blanks and figures.
coverage.whatNeedsGrading: Correct parentage, types, ordering, cardinality and cross-reference bindings.
coverage.currentSupport: Existing JSON structure and consumer cardinality checks are partial coverage.

coverage.modelContribution: LLM/Jev recognizes unreadable or conflicting evidence and selects next actions.
coverage.whatNeedsGrading: No invented fact; correct unresolved scope; useful alternatives; evidence-backed escalation.
coverage.currentSupport: Existing ambiguity preservation and Jev decision options; no universal confidence threshold.

coverage.modelContribution: LLM identifies points, lines, arcs, ticks, fills, labels and style.
coverage.whatNeedsGrading: Entity coverage and correct source-region attribution.
coverage.currentSupport: Historical figure IDs/assets exist; granular image-grounded entity grading still required.

coverage.modelContribution: LLM/Jev assigns incidence, endpoints, angle rays, point roles and relationships.
coverage.whatNeedsGrading: Correct links and mathematical constraints; no inference from handwriting or misleading geometry.
coverage.currentSupport: Coordinate drawing and some derived intersections/feet exist; a full independently checked relationship model is not established.

coverage.modelContribution: LLM produces editable text/math models and conversion code.
coverage.whatNeedsGrading: Source semantics retained; editable object structure; serialization mapping; no unsupported substitution.
coverage.currentSupport: Existing structured models and run mapping; rubric and original-image correspondence remain required.

coverage.modelContribution: LLM produces drawing code, coordinates, construction functions and labels.
coverage.whatNeedsGrading: Source fidelity, construction validity, stable entity bindings, meaningful parameters and editable dependencies.
coverage.currentSupport: Existing SVG code and raster checks; successful generation is not a semantic proof.

coverage.modelContribution: LLM/Jev represents option groups, tables, proof boxes and local placement.
coverage.whatNeedsGrading: Complete content, group relationships, readable placement and required editability.
coverage.currentSupport: Prior native models exist; evaluate the pre-export representation separately from later HWPX behavior.

coverage.modelContribution: LLM/Jev compares rendered output with original evidence.
coverage.whatNeedsGrading: Missing/extra symbols, labels, strokes, line style, glyphs, overlap and topology discrepancies.
coverage.currentSupport: Existing review predicates and visual observations; complete graded source-pair coverage not yet built.

coverage.modelContribution: LLM/Jev reports a defect, severity, patch target or escalation.
coverage.whatNeedsGrading: Known critical defects detected; valid controls accepted; localized evidence; calibrated uncertainty and useful next action.
coverage.currentSupport: Existing11 review propositions with assessment/severity/action/target outputs; they need independent score labels.

coverage.modelContribution: LLM/Jev selects which code/artifacts to patch, render or reuse.
coverage.whatNeedsGrading: All affected descendants updated; unrelated content preserved; no stale cache or unnecessary full regeneration.
coverage.currentSupport: Existing declared artifact/action dependency semantics; actual edit-invariance coverage remains to be qualified.

coverage.modelContribution: LLM/Jev chooses a bounded correction or interprets a failed attempt.
coverage.whatNeedsGrading: Actual defect corrected, source facts preserved, retries and uncertain effects accounted for, no hidden replay.
coverage.currentSupport: Existing accounting/qualification helpers; scoring must retain the failed and corrected outputs.

coverage.modelContribution: All admitted model contributions feed the final structured code and review preview.
coverage.whatNeedsGrading: End-to-end fidelity, traceable propagation, final unresolved defects and total generation/verification/human time/cost.
coverage.currentSupport: Common quality/improvement contracts and source observations exist; no Daechi model trial has yet been run.

coverage.modelContribution: A model grader judges another model output, or a deterministic grader applies expected predicates.
coverage.whatNeedsGrading: Independently fixed expected behavior; known-bad variants detected; valid controls passed; judge disagreement and evidence gaps explicit.
coverage.currentSupport: Common evaluator/CaseResult transport exists; a producer self-score is not independent evaluation.

traceabilityRequired: Grade, evidence class, uncertainty, time, cost and retained failed attempts
runtimeBoundary: Native Codex retains dispatch, sessions, tools and cancellation. Capture once, grade frozen outputs through existing source-owned evaluation contracts. No second agent runtime or substitute canonical identity store.
coverageInterpretation: An eligible unit is scored or explicitly records insufficient/not-applicable with a reason. Missing evidence is never silently promoted to pass.
registrationPrerequisite: Actual Local Herdr/native-Codex owner must provide genuine current authority and exact source graph to the existing v3 allocator. Synthetic fixture owners and caller-written membership flags are not production authority.
